final: WITH status_averages AS (SELECT CENTROMEA AS status, AVG(HGB) AS average_hemoglobin, AVG(`T-BIL` / CRE) AS average_ratio FROM Laboratory WHERE Date BETWEEN '1985-04-22' AND '1994-03-14' GROUP BY CENTROMEA), results AS (SELECT status, average_hemoglobin, average_ratio, AVG(average_ratio) OVER () AS overall_mean FROM status_averages) SELECT status, average_hemoglobin, average_ratio, average_ratio / overall_mean AS ratio_to_overall_mean FROM results WHERE overall_mean IS NOT NULL
